    tt={}

    class _Timeout(Exception): pass
    def search(h,v,player,alpha,beta):
        nonlocal nodes
        nodes += 1
        if (nodes & 255)==0 and time.perf_counter() > deadline:
            raise _Timeout
        if h == ALL_H and v == ALL_V:
            return 0
        key = (h << 26) | (v << 1) | (1 if player == 1 else 0)
        ent = tt.get(key)
        if ent is not None:
            val, flag = ent
            if flag == 0:
                return val
            if flag == 1 and val > alpha:
                alpha = val
            elif flag == 2 and val < beta:
                beta = val
            if alpha >= beta:
                return val
        a0, b0 = alpha, beta
        moves = _ordered_moves(h,v)
        if not moves:
            return 0
        if player == 1:
            best = -INF
            for _, eid, h2, v2, c in moves:
                val = c + search(h2, v2, player if c else -player, alpha - c, beta - c)
                if val > best:
                    best = val
                if best > alpha:
                    alpha = best
                if alpha >= beta:

                if val < best:
                    best = val
                if best < beta:
                    beta = best
                if alpha >= beta:
                    break
        if best <= a0:
            flag = 2

            flag = 1
        else:
            flag = 0

        return best
